acceptance_criteria.description: The fresh run retains the exact Terminal-Bench commit, Harbor executable and Docker version digests, pinned OCI image manifest, retained container identity, and network observation.
The unchanged regex-log verifier produces digest-bound CTRF and pytest stdout within the declared budget.
A no-provider result is classified from native verifier evidence and remains exploratory/non-claimable.
The report, record index, artifacts, and runtime receipts pass standalone verification from retained bytes.

objective: Run the unchanged no-provider regex-log verifier once under the existing preregistered 900-second exploratory plan and retain digest-bound Docker, image, container, network, cleanup, CTRF, stdout, and standalone-verification evidence. Preserve all prior probe records unchanged.
title: Capture fresh Terminal-Bench runtime identity receipt
